t: The Fuel Injection Port allow you to insert or extract fluid reactants that will fill your $(l:bigreactors:reactor/part-fuelrod)Fuel Rods$(/l) and power your Reactor.$(br2)In the graphical interface you can set the Port mode: in $(bold)inlet mode$() the Port will accept fluid fuel, in $(bold)outlet mode$() it will output fluid wastes.
燃料注入端口可以让你插入或提取流体反应物，它们会填充你的$(l:bigreactors:reactor/part-fuelrod)燃料棒$(/l)并为反应堆提供燃料。$(br2)在图形界面中你可以设置端口模式：在$(bold)入口模式$()下，端口会接受流体燃料；在$(bold)出口模式$()下，端口会输出流体废料。
A $(l:bigreactors/wrench)wrench$(/l) can be used to change the Port mode.$(br2)Unlike with the Solid Access Port, there is no loss of material using the Fuel Injection Port.
$(l:bigreactors/wrench)扳手$(/l)可用于切换端口模式。$(br2)与固体访问端口不同，使用燃料注入端口不会有材料损耗。

$(l)Mandatory:$() no$(br)$(l)Valid positions:$() any face (not on frame)$(br)$(l)Variants:$() Reinforced$(br)$(l)Graphical interface:$() yes$(br)$(l)Wrench:$() a $(l:bigreactors:misc/wrench)wrench$(/l) can be used to toggle the Port mode
